comment: Recognition layer 2 — community/district signs along the Airport→Ochi route. lat/lon are real-world and projected to world space at runtime via road.project(). radius is the trigger distance in compressed-world meters. needs_owner_review marks entries where the owner's lived knowledge should confirm or correct placement and naming.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The narrow limestone strip linking Norman Manley Airport to Kingston — sea on both sides, coconut trees along the road, Gun Boat Beach on the left

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Gateway from the Palisadoes strip into Kingston — the big roundabout onto Windward Road

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Home of the Rockfort Mineral Baths; industrial eastern Kingston

communities.name: East Kingston
communities.note: Working-class community along Windward Road into the city

communities.name: Cross Roads
communities.note: Major city junction — the gateway between downtown and uptown Kingston

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: The commercial heart of uptown Kingston — the 1813 clock tower marks the centre

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Jamaica's former colonial capital — the historic square is at the centre

communities.name: Angels
communities.note: Small community on the A1 north of Spanish Town, before the Bog Walk junction

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Entrance to the dramatic Rio Cobre gorge — Flat Bridge and limestone walls ahead

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: Industrial community in the gorge area, known for the bauxite alumina plant

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Famous for its bustling market and the Jamaican folk song 'Linstead Market'

communities.name: Guy's Hill
communities.note: Rural community in the hills between Linstead and Moneague

communities.name: Mount Rosser
communities.note: Hill-country stretch on the Linstead–Moneague road — commanding views north toward the coast

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Crossroads junction town in the cool hills of St. Ann — last stop before the coast run

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Legendary string of roadside cookshops — jerk chicken, roast yam and festival since the 1960s

communities.name: Milford
communities.note: Village at the crest before Fern Gully — the famous canopy begins just downhill

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Iconic 3 km canopy of tropical ferns and bamboo over the road — UNESCO-considered heritage

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: Tourist hub of the north coast — Dunn's River Falls is the journey's end
